MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

2. When learning Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.

3. When learning Photography, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Photography.

4. When learning Audio Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production.

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester

6. When learning Pre - Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre - Production.

7. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.

8. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.

9. When learning Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. When learning Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU
